# Flat Developer Documentation

> Developer documentation for Flat APIs and embedding features

## Table of Contents

### REST API

- [Flat API Authentication](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/authentication.md)
- [Untitled](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/reference.md)
- [Using our APIs with Flat for Education](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/flat-for-education.md)
- [Importing PDFs with OMR](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/omr-import.md): Import scanned sheet music (PDF) into Flat through our API using asynchronous Optical Music Recognition (OMR) tasks.
- [Instrument IDs](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/instruments.md): The catalog of instrument IDs used across the Flat API, for creating scores and correcting OMR-detected parts. Browse the full list or install the @flat/instruments package.
- [Flat REST API SDKs](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/sdks.md)
- [API Rate Limits](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/rate-limits.md): Discover how the Rate Limits of the Flat Platform's API.
- [Flat REST API Errors](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/errors.md)
- [Flat REST API Changelog](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/changelog.md): Discover the latest changes of Flat's REST API

### Embed

- [Getting started with our Music engraving Embed](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/getting-started.md): Discover how to quickly get started with our Sheet music embed.
- [Live Demos](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/demos.md): Explore live examples and demos of Flat's Embed API in action
- [Embeddable music notation editor](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/javascript-editor.md): Allow your website visitor and users to edit any sheet music
- [Sheet music Embed URL parameters](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/url-parameters.md): Quickly customize our music notation engraving embed with the different URL parameters available and add your own sheet music viewer on your website.
- [Sheet music oEmbed](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/oembed.md): Simply use our music notation engraving interactive embed in your web pages with the oEmbed standard.
- [How your usage is billed in Flat Embed?](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/usage-billing.md)
- [Embed SDK Changelog](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/changelog.md): Changelog for Flat's JavaScript/TypeScript Embed SDK (flat-embed)

#### JavaScript/TypeScript SDK

- [Installation & Setup](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/javascript.md): Install and set up the Flat Embed JavaScript/TypeScript SDK
- [API Reference](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api.md): Complete reference for the Flat Embed JavaScript SDK
- [Event System](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api/events.md): Subscribe to and handle embed events
- [Core Methods](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api/core.md): Essential methods for embed initialization and configuration
- [Score Management](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api/score-management.md): Methods for loading and exporting scores in various formats
- [Playback Control](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api/playback.md): Control playback, volume, speed, and metronome settings
- [Parts & Instruments](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api/parts.md): Manage individual parts, instruments, and their audio settings
- [Navigation & Cursor](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api/navigation.md): Navigate through the score and control cursor position
- [Display & View](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api/display.md): Control the visual presentation of the score
- [Score Data & Structure](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api/data.md): Access and query score structure, measures, notes, and metadata
- [Audio/Video Tracks](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/api/tracks.md): Synchronize external audio or video with the score

### Import API

- [Graphic assets](https://flat.io/developers/docs/import/assets.md): You can find here the assets you may need to integrate our APIs.

### LTI

- [LTI 1.3 (Advantage)](https://flat.io/developers/docs/lti/lti-1.3.md): Flat for Education LTI 1.3 Advantage integration documentation for platform developers and LMS administrators.
- [LTI 1.1 (Legacy)](https://flat.io/developers/docs/lti/lti-1.1.md): Flat for Education LTI 1.0 and 1.1 legacy integration documentation.

### Other

- [Certified LTI Provider](https://flat.io/developers/docs/lti/usage.md): Flat is an LTI Provider. If you are using an LTI consumer, check out our information on how you can use Flat with your product.
- [Flat Platform's REST API](https://flat.io/developers/docs/api/introduction.md): Use our high-quality music and tabs notation engraving in your web sites and blogs with our customizable and interactive HTML Embed.
- [Import API](https://flat.io/developers/docs/import/usage.md): Easy import any MusicXML or MIDI file available the Internet
- [Notices](https://flat.io/developers/docs/notices.md)
- [Sheet music Embed](https://flat.io/developers/docs/embed/introduction.md): Use our high-quality music and tabs notation engraving in your web sites and blogs with our customizable and interactive HTML Embed.
